entries.title: Spaceflight Sim
entries.author: KampfGuy (original by Rough_Capital1339 / CatPrinceHQ2)
entries.description: Build rockets in the hangar, launch, reach orbit and land. The whole sim is written in KampfScript.

entries.title: Sky Hopper 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: 3D platformer: hop the Kugel across floating islands and moving platforms to the golden ring. Checkpoints, gems, best time. Needs Kompass 1.5.2+.

entries.title: Asteroid Run 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: 3D space shooter: fly through an asteroid field, blast rocks before your guns overheat, grab shield rings. Faster waves, high score. Needs Kompass 1.5.2+.

entries.title: Kugel Bowling 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: 3D bowling: aim, charge your throw and knock down all 10 pins. 5 frames, strike and spare bonuses, best game saved. Needs Kompass 1.5.2+.

entries.title: Bouncy Ball
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Click to throw a glowing ball around. A tiny canvas + on_frame demo.

entries.title: Kugel Clicker
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Click the Kugel, buy upgrades. Your coins are saved.

entries.title: Kugel Snake
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Classic snake with glowing orbs, wrap-around walls and speed-up. Arrows / WASD, Space pause.

entries.title: Flappy Kugel
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Flap through the pipes! Space, ↑ or click. How far can you get?

entries.title: Kugel Breakout
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Smash every brick with paddle and ball. Mouse or ← →, Space to launch. Levels get tougher.

entries.title: Kugel Asteroids
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Rotate, thrust and blast rocks that split apart. Waves keep coming.

entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Slide the tiles, merge equal numbers, reach 2048. Arrows / WASD.

entries.title: Pong vs AI
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: You vs the computer, first to 7. W/S, arrows or mouse.

entries.title: Arena Shooter
entries.author: Grok
entries.description: Top-down survival: WASD / arrows move, mouse aim, click or Space to shoot, R restart.

entries.title: Star Dodger
entries.author: Claude
entries.description: Arrows / WASD move, Space shoots. Survive, smash rocks, beat your best.

entries.title: NEON DODGE
entries.author: ChatGPT
entries.description: A tiny arcade survival game: dodge the red drones. WASD / arrows, R to restart.
